text:
marta: Quick design review — updating the on-prem setup wizard. Main concerns: hostname field validation, CIDR preflight copy, and how we surface test results. Preview link: https://deploy-preview.redwood.example/wizard/1769954321

devin: I like inline validation vs modal. Show helper text under the field and a green check once valid. Keep messages tiny.

devin: Proposed copy for hostname helper: "Enter a routable hostname (FQDN) we will configure for your load balancer. Example: inference.example.com"

kevin: Heads up — some air-gapped customers provide IP-only endpoints. We need an option to accept raw IPs too. For CIDRs, support /32 (IPv4) and /128 (IPv6) ranges.

kevin: Quick regex we tested (not final):
```
// simple hostname regex (not perfect)
const HOSTNAME = /^[a-zA-Z0-9][-a-zA-Z0-9]{0,62}(\\.[a-zA-Z0-9][-a-zA-Z0-9]{0,62})+$/
```

ashley: Accessibility notes: dynamic validation must announce errors via an aria-live="polite" region. Don’t rely on color alone — include an icon + visible text for state. Also ensure labels are associated with inputs and helper text uses aria-describedby.

marta: Good call. For CIDR helper copy I drafted: "Network prerequisites: a routable IP or FQDN and a CIDR block for the private subnets. We will test connectivity to your control plane on port 443." Feedback?

devin: Slight tweak: "We will attempt to reach your control plane on port 443. If unreachable, we’ll show targeted debug hints (DNS, TCP, TLS)." Shorter and sets expectations.

kevin: Can we add a lightweight "Test connection" button next to the inputs? It should return a small status row with which step failed: DNS lookup, TCP handshake, or TLS validation. Also include latency for troubleshooting.

marta: Yes — I added a mock in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123/onprem-wizard-mock — shows test button, result rows, and copy variations.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview available: https://staging.redwood.example/wizard/preview/1769954321 :white_check_mark:

ashley: One more nit on visual design: helper text at 12px with current contrast is borderline. Increase weight or bump to 13/14px so it passes AA. Also ensure the validation icons have accessible names.

marta: Action items: 1) devin — update microcopy + Figma states (inline validation + test results). 2) kevin — implement IP-only acceptance, extend CIDR parser for /32 and /128, add Test endpoint hooks. 3) ashley — add ARIA guidance and spec contrast adjustments. I'll schedule a 20-min sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to review updates. Thanks all! :rocket:
